- **Science Centre:** 
The Museums Montréal listing gives holiday hours of 10:00 - 17:00 on Dec 27, 28, 29 and 30, and says the Mini Mondo exhibition is for children under 7.
 No price was on that page.
- **Biodôme:** 
The listing shows regular hours from Sep 2 to Apr 30 of 9:00 - 17:00 Tuesday to Sunday, with Monday closed.
 
All Espace pour la vie museums are closed on December 24 and 25.
 Dec 27, 2026 is a Sunday, so Monday Dec 28 falls under the regular Monday closure. I did not find a separate holiday-hours entry for Dec 26 to 30. No price was posted.
- **Zükari:** 
Their site says it opens from 1:00 pm on December 26 and is closed December 24 and 25.
 I did not find its hours for Dec 27 to 30, or a price.

I left out the Insectarium. The only schedule I saw for it was the May to September one. I also left out Kazoom Café and the rest of the indoor-playground listings, because I found no hours for those dates.
